name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) makes reaching the exit a goal, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires the box in hand on the exit step (the 'carry the box to the exit' requirement), and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) matches 'pick it up again on your very next move' with the right next-step timing. Priorities are hard as worded, all propositions are declared, and no clause is redundant or added.

texts: At the exit, the box is in hand.
Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on the very next move.
